item.text: {"schema":"voice-draft-claim-audit/4","sentences":[{"id":"p1s1","status":"keep","reason":"This is a recommendation for the meeting, with stated conditions for any later use; it does not assert that a review or contract currently exists.","claims":[]},{"id":"p1s2","status":"disclose","reason":"The sentence asserts a practical benefit of AI summarization that the request does not supply; the remaining question identifies data-control issues to investigate rather than asserting who actually has those powers.","claims":[{"claim":"Using an AI service to summarize intake notes can make case review faster.","kind":"broad-generalization","verification_question":"What evidence shows that the contemplated AI summarization service would make this nonprofit’s case review faster?"}]},{"id":"p2s1","status":"keep","reason":"This is a procedural recommendation about which vendor documents to examine and adds no claim about the vendor’s current terms.","claims":[]},{"id":"p2s2","status":"keep","reason":"Each clause directs the nonprofit to confirm or require specific data-use, access, retention, subprocessor, and breach-notice conditions; none claims that those conditions currently hold.","claims":[]},{"id":"p2s3","status":"keep","reason":"This is a list of recommended technical, access-control, accountability, and correction requirements, not a description of existing safeguards.","claims":[]},{"id":"p2s4","status":"keep","reason":"This is a proposed decision rule: absent written commitments, the nonprofit should withhold the notes.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s1","status":"keep","reason":"This recommends limiting tests to invented or fully de-identified records even if safeguards are obtained; it reports no actual test or external practice.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s2","status":"disclose","reason":"The sentence makes independently checkable claims about errors AI-generated summaries can produce; the wrong-drawer comparison is an analogy derived from those claims.","claims":[{"claim":"AI-generated summaries can remove or understate uncertainty present in source notes.","kind":"broad-generalization","verification_question":"What evidence shows that AI summarization can flatten uncertainty in confidential or comparable notes?"},{"claim":"AI-generated summaries can omit safety-relevant details from source notes.","kind":"broad-generalization","verification_question":"What evidence shows that AI summarization can omit safety-relevant details?"},{"claim":"AI-generated summaries can present tentative source statements as established facts.","kind":"broad-generalization","verification_question":"What evidence shows that AI summarization can convert tentative statements into apparently factual assertions?"}]},{"id":"p3s3","status":"keep","reason":"All clauses are recommendations governing record retention, labeling, metadata, and staff review before action; they do not describe current organizational practice.","claims":[]},{"id":"p3s4","status":"keep","reason":"This states the proposed allocation of authority between an assisting tool and human decision-makers, rather than claiming how a real tool or organization currently operates.","claims":[]},{"id":"p4s1","status":"keep","reason":"The entire sentence proposes a narrow resolution and future workflow for review, approval, a de-identified pilot, and reporting; it does not claim those steps or roles are currently in place.","claims":[]},{"id":"p4s2","status":"keep","reason":"This characterizes the proposed pause-and-review resolution as conditional rather than a permanent prohibition, which follows from the proposal itself.","claims":[]},{"id":"p4s3","status":"keep","reason":"This is a metaphorical characterization of the proposed controlled, reversible pilot and adds no external descriptive premise.","claims":[]},{"id":"p4s4","status":"keep","reason":"This is a collective value judgment and approval rule prioritizing confidentiality, enforceable vendor limits, and human review; it does not assert present facts about the organization or vendor.","claims":[]}]}
